title: DOW-UAP-D25, Mission Report, Greece, January 2024
doc_notes: This document is a declassified Mission Report (MISREP) from USCENTCOM detailing a UAP sighting on January 25, 2024, characterized by heavy redactions of operational and personnel information.

incidents.summary: A UAP was observed by a military asset while in transit, appearing as a diamond shape with a non-maneuvering probe at the bottom, visible only via SWIR sensor.
incidents.quote: THE UAP APPEARED DIAMOND IN SHAPE WITH A NON-MANUEVERING PROBE AT THE BOTTOM. THE UAP ONLY APPEARED ON THE SWIR CAMERA.
incidents.shape: round diamond shape with straight, non-maneuverable tail
